Class Team

  • Constructor Details

    • Team

      public Team(int color, ArrayList<Agent> agents)
      Attempts to create a new team from the provided list of agents, advancing the idGenerator to the next value only if the team can be created successfully
      Parameters:
      color - the color for this team's agents
      agents - a list of the agents to be added to this team
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the agents list is empty
      IllegalStateException - if the agents list contains more than one Lead

      public void addMember(Agent a) throws IllegalStateException
      Adds the given agent to this team's list. If the agent is already present in this team's members list, this method does nothing.
      Parameters:
      a - the agent to add to the list
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the agent is a Lead that is not already present in the list

      public void sendToParty(Party p)

      Parameters:

    • lineUp

      public void lineUp()
      Updates the destination of all team members so that the team formation becomes a line centered at getCenterX/getCenterY. Each member should be allocated their diameter + 3 pixels worth of space in the line, to avoid overlapping with the agent next to them.

      Hint: the total width of this line is equal to ((diameter+3)*teamSize)-3.
